clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken Duties is a reconnaissance mission assigned by Magistrate Sevren in Brill to assess Scourge activity along the eastern perimeter of Tirisfal Glades. It establishes the constant threat posed by the Scourge slipping past The Bulwark and endangering local settlements.

Magistrate Sevren oversees the security of Brill and the surrounding countryside, keeping a nervous eye on the eastern borders of Tirisfal Glades. With the Scourge swarming across the Western Plaguelands, Sevren requires constant reconnaissance from frontline sentries to ensure undead horrors do not slip past the perimeter unnoticed. Travelers willing to assist are dispatched south and east down the main thoroughfare to gather an urgent tactical assessment from Deathguard Linnea.

Stationed at an eastern outpost along the road, Deathguard Linnea observes the frontier firsthand. Her findings confirm the magistrates fears: while the fortified position at The Bulwark successfully holds off the main Scourge host, small groups of undead manage to bypass the defenses on occasion. These stray forces have begun congregating around the nearby Balnir Farmstead, posing a localized but dangerous threat to Tirisfal Glades.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal. Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!
Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation. Speak with Deathguard Linnea. She has the information I need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Magistrate Sevren wants a report? Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.
We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
